subject: Mathematics
title: Vector Algebra
summary: Vectors mein magnitude aur direction dono hote hain; a = a₁î + a₂ĵ + a₃k̂ (components). Ye triangle/parallelogram law se judte hain, aur koi bhi vector teen non-coplanar vectors mein likha ja sakta hai. a/|a| unit vector hai.
Dot product a · b = |a||b| cos θ se angles, projections aur perpendicularity milti hai. Cross product a × b = |a||b| sin θ n̂ se areas aur dono ke perpendicular vector milta hai.
Scalar triple product [a b c] parallelepiped ka volume deta hai aur coplanarity test karta hai; vector triple product a × (b × c) = (a · c)b − (a · b)c expand hota hai.

formulas.name: Section formula (vectors)
formulas.formula: internal m:n → (mb + na)/(m + n);  midpoint (a + b)/2
formulas.when: Divide karne wale points ke position vectors.

formulas.name: Dot product
formulas.formula: a · b = |a||b| cos θ = a₁b₁ + a₂b₂ + a₃b₃;  a ⊥ b ⇔ a · b = 0

formulas.name: Projection
formulas.formula: projection of a on b = (a · b)/|b|;  vector projection = ((a · b)/|b|²) b
formulas.when: Ek vector ka doosre ke saath component.

formulas.name: Cross product
formulas.formula: a × b = |a||b| sin θ n̂ = determinant |î ĵ k̂; a₁ a₂ a₃; b₁ b₂ b₃|;  a × b = −b × a;  a ∥ b ⇔ a × b = 0

formulas.name: Areas
formulas.formula: parallelogram with sides a, b: |a × b|;  with diagonals d₁, d₂: ½|d₁ × d₂|;  triangle: ½|a × b|

formulas.name: Scalar triple product
formulas.formula: [a b c] = a · (b × c) = determinant of components;  volume of parallelepiped = |[a b c]|;  tetrahedron = |[a b c]|/6

formulas.name: Coplanarity
formulas.formula: a, b, c coplanar ⇔ [a b c] = 0
formulas.when: Vectors ek plane mein hain ya nahi, test karna.

formulas.name: Vector triple product
formulas.mistake: Aam taur par a × (b × c) ≠ (a × b) × c — brackets mat badlo.

formulas.name: Properties of [a b c]
formulas.formula: [a b c] = [b c a] = [c a b] = −[b a c];  [a a b] = 0;  [a × b  b × c  c × a] = [a b c]²

formulas.name: Collinearity
formulas.formula: points A, B, C collinear ⇔ AB = λ AC (or AB × AC = 0)

formulas.name: Lagrange identity
formulas.when: Dot aur cross products ko jodna.

examples.title: Dot product aur angle
examples.problem: a = î + 2ĵ + 2k̂, b = 2î − ĵ + 2k̂. a · b aur unke beech angle nikalo.

examples.title: Projection
examples.problem: Upar wale vectors ke liye a ka b par projection?

examples.title: Parallelogram ka area
examples.problem: Upar wale a aur b sides wale parallelogram ka area?

examples.title: Volume
examples.problem: Edges î, 2ĵ aur î + ĵ + 3k̂ wale parallelepiped ka volume?

examples.title: Perpendicular unit vector
examples.problem: î + ĵ aur ĵ + k̂ dono ke perpendicular unit vector?
examples.solution: (î + ĵ) × (ĵ + k̂) = î − ĵ + k̂; √3 se divide ⇒ ±(î − ĵ + k̂)/√3.

topics.title: Types of vectors
topics.explain: Zero vector, unit vector, equal vectors, collinear (parallel) vectors, coinitial vectors, coplanar vectors, point P ka position vector OP.

topics.title: Linear combinations
topics.explain: Do non-collinear vectors ek plane span karte hain; teen non-coplanar vectors poora space. Agar ek vector baaki ka combination ho to vectors linearly dependent hain.

topics.title: Angle bisectors with vectors
topics.explain: a aur b ke beech angle ka internal bisector â + b̂ ke saath; external bisector â − b̂ ke saath.

topics.title: Work and moment
topics.explain: Force F ka displacement d mein kaam F · d hai. Kisi point ke about F ka moment (torque) r × F hai.

topics.title: Direction cosines with vectors
topics.explain: r = xî + yĵ + zk̂ ke direction cosines x/|r|, y/|r|, z/|r| hain. Axes se barabar angle banane wala unit vector (î + ĵ + k̂)/√3 hai.

topics.title: Common mistakes
topics.explain: Dot product scalar deta hai, cross product vector. a · b = a · c se b = c nahi nikalta. Cross product na associative hai na commutative.

ratta: a · b = |a||b| cos θ;  ⊥ ⇔ a · b = 0.
|a × b| = area of parallelogram;  ½ for triangle.
